description: A set of helper functions for managing etcd instances in Kubernetes testing environment, including validation, start, stop, scrape, install, and cleanup operations.

methods.name: kube::etcd::validate
methods.description: Validates the presence and version of etcd, and checks if the port is free.

methods.name: kube::etcd::version
methods.description: Converts version string to comparable integer format.

methods.name: kube::etcd::start
methods.description: Starts an etcd server instance with specified configuration.

methods.name: kube::etcd::start_scraping
methods.description: Begins periodic scraping of etcd metrics.

methods.name: kube::etcd::scrape
methods.description: Fetches metrics from etcd and saves to a file.

methods.name: kube::etcd::stop
methods.description: Stops the running etcd server and scraping processes.

methods.name: kube::etcd::cleanup
methods.description: Stops etcd and cleans up data directory.

methods.name: kube::etcd::install
methods.description: Downloads and installs etcd binary suitable for the host OS.
